desc: Derive and implement precise parent-edge-selected DP states and transitions, including distinction between a leaf and an internal degree-4 vertex.
Select the best three/four positive child DP contributions efficiently and evaluate every vertex as a possible highest selected degree-4 vertex.
Implement iterative rooting and bottom-up traversal safely for N up to 2e5.
Validate correctness against representation by highest selected vertex and edge cases (insufficient children, star center, no alkane).
